NDI® output
TileSmith uses NDI® to send its master canvas over your network as a live video source. Learn about NDI® at https://ndi.video/. The full NDI® Tools (Studio Monitor, Webcam, Screen Capture and more) are available from https://ndi.video/tools/.
NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB.
NDI® license
The desktop app includes the NDI® runtime library from the NDI® SDK (Processing.NDI.Lib.x64.dll on Windows, libndi.dylib on Mac), © Vizrt NDI AB. It is distributed under, and its use is subject to, the NDI® SDK License Agreement (ndi.link/ndisdk_license). The NDI® runtime uses third-party libraries; their license notices are included with TileSmith. NDI® Tools are not included and are not distributed with TileSmith.
Spout and Syphon
The Windows app can include SpoutDX from the Spout SDK by Lynn Jarvis (spout.zeal.co), Simplified BSD licence. The Mac app can include the Syphon framework by Tom Butterworth & Anton Marini (syphon.github.io), BSD licence, and node-syphon by Benoît Lahoz, MIT licence. Their licence texts ship with TileSmith.

Preferences
Changes the font used by menus, labels and this window. OpenDyslexic is a typeface designed to help with reading. Your choice is saved and restored next time.
Changes the language of menus, labels and messages. Product names, NDI®, Spout and Syphon stay in English. Spanish and Portuguese are first drafts: tell us what reads wrong.
Your crew, canvas, wall, tile model, patterns, uploads and options are saved automatically and restored next time.
